title: Authorized Work Must Remain Preserved, Visible, and Continuously Routed
statement: When the user explicitly submits an artifact for induction, the instruction authorizes preservation, queue registration, and continued governed processing until the artifact is represented in research or a visible governed blocker is recorded.
formal_expression: EXPLICIT_INDUCTION(x) => PRESERVE(x) AND QUEUE_REGISTER(x) AND CONTINUE_UNTIL(RESEARCH_REGISTERED(x) OR RESEARCH_BLOCKED_VISIBLE(x))
